visual_action: A montage of scenes from a large-scale pro-choice march. The video shows diverse crowds of people marching in the streets of a city, holding signs and banners with slogans supporting abortion rights. The shots include wide views of the crowd, medium shots of groups marching, and close-ups of individuals and their signs.

cast.name: Pro-choice protestors
cast.evidence: The entire video consists of footage of protestors at a pro-choice rally.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official '@democrats' account.

on_screen_text.text: I had a baby & I had an abortion MOMS ♥️ bodily autonomy
A MOTHER BY CHOICE FOR CHOICE

spoken_summary: There is no speech or dialogue in the video; it is set entirely to instrumental music.
audio_music: A poignant and dramatic instrumental track featuring piano and strings plays consistently throughout the video, creating an emotional and inspirational atmosphere.
editing_pacing: The video is a moderately paced montage of various clips from the protest, cutting between different scenes and people to show the scale and diversity of the event.
central_claim: The movement to protect abortion rights is strong, diverse, and continues to actively protest for bodily autonomy.
intended_effect: To inspire and energize supporters of abortion rights by showcasing the power and scale of the pro-choice movement.
